purpose: Regenerate the locked-V9-only three-pose panel after V32 attempt 1 failed internal source readability. Preserve the successful menu page-tabs concept, enforce exactly one recording mouth contour, and enforce a continuous connected charging route from cheek coupler to slotted energy dock. This source must make Menu, Recording and Charging distinct at a glance at native 200x200 without V32 attempt-1 or any rejected image as visual input.
v9_identity_and_simplicity_invariants: retain exact locked V9 floating-face identity: black oval eyes, one oval highlight and one diamond sparkle per eye, eye scale/spacing/baseline, nose, cheeks, line weight, wide white margins and no enclosing head, hair, ears, helmet, body, frame or card
each state has exactly three separately extractable black functional components, with no component larger than half a V9 eye or covering an eye/brow
mouths differ pairwise by pixel mask, topology, endpoint pattern and curvature; they cannot share a mask or be offset/scale variants
menu is three separated notched page tabs, recording is two receiver cuffs plus pickup, charging is a visibly continuous side-coupler-to-tether-to-slotted-dock route
no literal battery, lightning, microphone, waveform, plug, menu icon, text, label, detached UI widget, generic emotion substitution, headband, costume or whole-face prop

state_object_semantic_brief.one_glance_read: navigation and choosing, not hair, dots or crown
state_object_semantic_brief.mouth_action: short straight decision mouth with two horizontal endpoints and exactly one centred downward selection notch
state_object_semantic_brief.topology: three separated page-shaped tabs over brows, with a raised central tab and one white folded-corner notch

state_object_semantic_brief.one_glance_read: active capture and listening, not surprise, a moustache or a costume headset
state_object_semantic_brief.mouth_action: exactly one and only one shallow wide rounded horizontal listening capsule below the nose; never draw a second capsule, second horizontal bar, duplicate inner loop or stacked mouth
state_object_semantic_brief.topology: two thin open cheek-side C cuffs with inward contact ticks, plus one small round pickup dot offset to the right of the one mouth; no head bridge, earcup, boom, microphone or waveform

state_object_semantic_brief.one_glance_read: connected power transfer and recovery, not a decorative star/string
state_object_semantic_brief.mouth_action: small smooth upward recovery smile with gently lifted endpoints and an open white interior
state_object_semantic_brief.topology: the tether must be one unbroken visible black line from the left cheek-side coupler to the side edge of the small rounded dock above the brows; no gap is permitted. The dock contains a horizontal white contact slot. Keep the entire route compact, connected and within the face width.

source_gate_readability_requirements: native 200x200 crops must be internally assignable as Menu, Recording and Charging without captions
recording must contain exactly one mouth ink island below the nose and one distinct pickup dot; a stacked capsule or duplicate bar fails
charging must have continuous 8-connected tether ink from side coupler to the dock boundary; a visual gap fails
menu must have exactly three separated page tabs and one raised notched centre; hair/dots/crown interpretation fails
all states satisfy V9 half-eye component budget, zero component overlap, no forbidden prop and pairwise mouth difference before export or owner review
machine_preconditions_before_owner_revie: source gate validates locked-V9-only lineage, source topology and native-200 readability requirements
component export and causal performance use source-derived parts only with no whole-face substitution
browser and target PBM replay the identical deterministic native-200 component plan

internal visual preflight rejects unreadable state semantics, shared/offset mouths, duplicate recording mouth, disconnected charging tether, oversized/costume props and source misuse before an owner prompt
